name: Chore
about: Suggest a performance improvement and/or deps update
title: chore/[NAME]

---

_Note: Ensure to rewrite the default issue title to capture a very brief summary (several words at most) of what the proposed performance improvement is._

_E.g. chore/update-pydantic-v4_


**User Story:**
Explain in a user story what you want to implement, who it effects and why its a valuable change to make. 
_E.g. As a [USER] I want to be able to..._

**Rough Implementation Plan:**
What are the rough steps you plan to take to implement this feature?
_E.g. 

Step 1).  Update to v4 of `Pydantic` in `pyproject.toml`
Step 2).  Find and replace all imports of `Pydantic` in the source code
Step 3).  Update all pydantic instances to use new format
_

**What does successful implementation look like?:**
I.e. How do we verify the change was implemented successfully? Are there additional tests which should pass etc.

**Additional context:**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
